hypotheses.L1_sparse_oracle_edges_are_downstream_ca: Eight locally strongest edges reach at least 0.10 median target projection by insertion or removal in some layer on both corpora.
hypotheses.L2_sparse_edges_beat_random_controls: At the best layer, oracle-eight absolute target projection is at least twice random-eight on both corpora.
hypotheses.L3_frozen_recurrent_heads_are_downstream: The frozen FineWeb-discovered recurrent head reaches at least 0.10 target projection in some layer on both corpora.
hypotheses.L4_direct_source_edges_are_a_major_downs: All direct edited-source edges reach at least 0.20 target projection in some layer on both corpora.
hypotheses.L5_local_edge_score_predicts_downstream_: Across sites and layers, local oracle-eight signed projection correlates at least 0.50 with downstream removal target projection on both corpora.
hypotheses.L6_insertion_and_removal_agree: Oracle-eight insertion and removal downstream target projections correlate at least 0.70 on both corpora.
